response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced senior engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, and backend systems, including some genuinely high-scale work (millions of requests/second at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic). However, the role is a Principal/IC6 position centered on experimentation platforms, growth measurement, telemetry, and statistical analysis — none of which appear in the resume. There is no evidence of building experimentation frameworks, feature flagging, metrics infrastructure, or leading multi-team, cross-workstream initiatives at principal scope. The profile reads as a strong senior/staff generalist rather than a principal-level experimentation systems architect.
strengths: 15+ years of broad engineering experience across many languages and stacks, including required ones (JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, C#, C/C++)
Proven high-scale, low-latency distributed systems work handling millions of HTTP requests per second
Recent hands-on AI tooling experience (MCP code generators, agentic workflow infrastructure) matching a preferred qualification
concerns: No experimentation, A/B testing, feature-flagging, or growth-measurement platform experience — the core of the role
No demonstrated telemetry/metrics infrastructure or statistical analysis background
No evidence of principal-level scope: leading multi-team initiatives, cross-org influence, or systems adopted by multiple teams

key_factors.factor: Strong engineering fundamentals and high-scale systems experience
